: 
Rama Raman Mishra 
Counsel for Respondent(s) 
Sandeep Kumar Srivastava vs State Of U.P. And Ors. on 8 October, 2025

: 
G.A. 
 Court No. - 13 HON'BLE SAURABH LAVANIA, J. 
1. Heard Sri Rama Raman Mishra, the learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Ajay Kumar Srivastava, the learned A.G.A for the State.

2. Present petition has been filed for the following main relief(s):-
" (I) Issue a writ order or direction in the nature of certiorari thereby quashing the impugned Revisional order dated 21.01.2021 passed by opposite party no.1 i.e.
Additional Sessions Judge/Special Judge Gangster Act, Room No.14, Sultanpur (contained as Annexure No.1 to the writ petition) as well as order dated 03.01.2020 passed by learned chief Judicial Magistrate Room No.16, Sultanpur passed in application of the petitioner filed under section 156 (3) of Cr.P.C. (contained as Annexure No.2 to the writ petition) in the interest of justice.

entities.text: Additional Sessions Judge/Special Judge Gangster Act, Room No.14, Sultanpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
II. Issue a writ order or direction in the nature of mandamus thereby directing to the Station House Officer Kotwali Nagar, District Sultanpur to lodge/register the first information report against the opposite party no. 2 and 3 and investigate the matter in view of the application filed under section 156 (3) of Cr.P.C. contained as Annexure No.3 and direct to investigate the matter, in the interest of justice."
3.

The relevant facts appears from the application referred by the petitioner in terms of the application under Section 156(3) Cr.P.C, which has been annexed as Annexure No.4 to the affidavit filed in support of the petition are in nutshell to the effect that the officials of bank without any information converted the 'Business Loan' related to 'Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojna' and, therefore,
they committed the offence under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468, 471 I.P.C.
4.
The Magistrate taking note of the facts pleaded rejected the complaint vide order dated 03.01.2020 5.

The order of the Magistrate was assailed by the petitioner by means of a Criminal Revision No.
07/2020, which has been rejected by the Additional District Session Judge/Special Judge, Gangster Act, Court No.14, Sultanpur (in short Revisional Court).

sentences.text: Upon due consideration of the facts indicated in the application under Section 156(3) Cr.P.C as also submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner as also learned A.G.A, this Court finds that in the instant matter no interference is required for the reason that to establish the fact as pleaded in the application under Section 156(3) Cr.P.C, the loan agreement has not been placed on record as also that to the view of this Court just to avoid the payment of the loan amount, the present application under Section 156(3)Cr.P.C was filed which amounts just to giving criminal colour to a dispute which is purely civil in nature.
8. Accordingly, the present petition stands dismissed.
